- ( ) Ekdum simple, quick aur full-on flavour wali sabji! Crispy sev ko masaledaar tomato-onion gravy mein toss karke banne wali yeh dish is perfect for those days when you want something delicious without spending hours in the kitchen.
Preparation time 5 minutes
Cooking time 15-20 minutes
Serve 2-4
Ingredients
For Ginger Green Chilli Paste
1 inch Ginger (peeled & sliced), adrak
2-3 no. Green Chillies (less spicy & roughly torn), hari mirch
